answer: Rewards flow first-sealed, never copied. When the ocean of daily attestations opens at dawn, the ledger pays the full nectar only to the earliest sealed hash of each distinct work item; every later re-seal of the same work earns zero. Each fake identity still owes its 900 POA registration levy, so a farm of 100 duplicates forfeits 90,000 POA in levies while winning zero nectar, while one honest originator is paid once and in full.
